name: ASYMMETRIC_CUBIC_OBFUSCATION
description: Replaced the easily simplified modular arithmetic with a cubic polynomial equality condition. The new formula mathematically reduces to x = y for all valid inputs, but intertwines the node labels (u, w) with the speeds (x, y) in a way that prevents simple algebraic decoupling. This directly implements the suggested strategy to prevent the assigned speed from dividing away its own squared term, forcing models to either dynamically evaluate the constraints perfectly or fail when attempting algebraic simplification.
